correctness.rationale: Munn coordinates (T,t) encode the prefix-visited subtree. R fixes rooted T, L fixes its translation to the terminal-rooted copy, and D fixes the unrooted edge-labeled tree up to group left translation; free terminal/start vertices correspond to endpoints to optimize. Any tree walk from s to u covering all e edges has length ≥2e−dist(s,u): each on-path edge is required odd and ≥1 crossing, each off-path edge even and ≥2; branch excursions attain equality. Thus optimizing one/both endpoints gives eccentricities/diameter and all Green shortest lengths, including empty word. For O(n) work space, re-free-reduce individual prefixes as needed, keeping at most two O(n)-length stacks and O(log n) counters for pairwise equality/distance and uniqueness scans; polynomial repeated scans avoid storing O(n²) prefix strings. Complement uses the same deterministic total decider. An independent exhaustive rank-one length≤9 and rank-two length≤5 short-word census (1023 and 1365 words) grouped true Munn Green invariants and matched all four formulas; not an unbounded proof.
residual_risks: The finite computations do not establish the unrestricted theorem; the argument in the pinned RESULT.md supplies the universal quantifiers.
